target: 788 Realizationes

source: 788 Realizations
target: 788 Realizationes

source: Seeing the Magic Mirror Divination come to an end, Lumian turned his gaze to Anthony.
target: Cum Divinatio Speculi Magici finem attigerit, Lumian oculos suos ad Anthony convertit.

source: “The Newins has definitely fled.
target: “Newins certe fugerunt.

source: Go out and gather information from the pirates.
target: Exi et a piratis notitias colligas.

source: Find out if Great Shark Jörg and the key crew members managed to board the ship.
target: Inquire num Magnus Squalus Jörg et nautae praecipui navem conscenderint.

source: If they didn’t, find out where they are now.”
target: Si non, inquere ubi nunc sint.

source: “Understood.”
target: “Intellectum.”

source: Anthony knew Lumian wanted to quickly determine the whereabouts of Great Shark Jörg and his men to see if they could use them to “visit” the Newins again and learn about the elves and the true nature of the Lost Newins.
target: Anthony scivit Lumian celeriter videre velle ubi esset Magnus Squalus Jörg eiusque milites, ut comprobet num eos ad Newins iterum “visitandum” adhibere possent atque de elfis ac de vera natura Newins Perditorum discere.

source: Lumian couldn’t go himself; the pirates would avoid him, and even if he forced the information out of them, it would alert Great Shark Jörg and his men if they were still in Banamo Port, making them hide deeper.
target: Lumian ipse ire non potuit; piratae eum vitabant, et etiam si eorum notitias colligere coegisset, hoc Magnus Squalus Jörg eiusque milites, si in Portu Banamo adhuc erant, certiorem fecisset, eosque in altiora latebras ageret.

source: Disguising himself wouldn’t work either; the pirates wouldn’t be friendly or forthcoming.
target: Se celare non sufficeret; piratae neque comiter se gererent neque aperte responderent.

source: The same applied to Franca.
target: Idem de Franca agebat.

source: Only Anthony, who had befriended many pirates, could naturally obtain the needed intel.
target: Solus Anthony, qui multis piratis amicus fuisset, notitias necessarias naturaliter acquirere poterat.

source: After watching Anthony leave the room, Franca sat down at the desk with a sigh.
target: Postquam Anthonym ex conclavi discessisse vidit, Franca cum suspirio ad mensam consedit.

source: “This whole transmigration thing keeps getting more complicated.”
target: “Haec omnis transmigratio semper magis intricata videtur.”

source: “You used to treat it too simply,” Lumian scoffed.
target: “Olim id nimis simpliciter tractabaris,” derisit Lumian.

source: Franca didn’t argue, staying silent for a moment before changing the subject.
target: Franca non contradixit, paulisper tacita mansit antequam rem mutare coepit.

source: “I’ve fully digested the Pleasure potion.
target: “Potionem Voluptatis penitus digestam habeo.

source: After a few days of rest, I’ll be ready to attempt the Demoness of Affliction ritual.”
target: Post paucos dies quietis, paratus ero tentare ritum Demonissae Afflictionis.”

source: “Honestly, it feels like a dream.
target: “Revera, tamquam somnium videtur.

source: Have I really digested it?”
target: Num id vere penitus digestum habeo?

source: She still seemed somewhat incredulous.
target: Illa tamen aliquantulum incredula videbatur.

source: Lumian chuckled in response.
target: Lumian subridens respondit.

source: “What else were you expecting?”
target: “Quid aliud exspectabas?

source: If Admiral Deep Sea knew our main goal was to help you digest the Pleasure potion, he’d think the world was absurd.
target: Si Admiral Profundi Maris sciret finem nostrum principalem esse tibi in potionem Voluptatis digestione auxilium ferre, mundum absurdum putaret.

source: He’d wonder if it was necessary and suggest that with a Demoness of Pleasure’s conditions, we could have just asked for his help with a notarized agreement to prevent harm, and he’d happily assist.”
target: Mirabatur num id necessarium esset et suadebat ut, cum condicionibus Demonissae Voluptatis, auxilium eius per pactum legitimum ad damna vitanda petivissemus, quod libenter adiuvaret.

source: “It’s just hard for me to accept…” Franca muttered.
target: “Mihi hoc accipere vere difficile est…”

source: “And I know what you mean.”
target: “Et scio quid dicas.”

source: In our world, plenty would say, “Helping a Demoness of Pleasure digest a potion is too wicked—please let me help,” but that’s superficial pleasure and low‐quality digestion.
target: In nostro orbe multi dixerunt: “Auxilium ferre Demonissae Voluptatis potionem digerere nimis improbat—quaeso, sinite me auxiliari,” sed id est voluptas superficialis et digestio mediocris.

source: Real pleasure comes from experiencing it in pain and sinking into it.
target: Vera voluptas ex dolore experiendo et in eo se immergendo nascitur.

source: Targeting people like Moran Avigny and Howl Constantine aligns more with the essence of the Demoness path.
target: Eligio hominum similium Moran Avigny et Howl Constantine magis cum essentia viae Demonissae convenit.

source: Lumian was just joking and didn’t continue the topic.
target: Lumian solum iocabatur et rem non prosequi voluit.

source: Franca was silent for a while.
target: Franca paulisper tacita mansit.

source: Then she looked at Lumian and carefully said, “About your plan to spread a plague among the pirates in Banamo Port—I don’t think it’s viable.”
target: Tum Lumian spectavit et caute inquit: “De consilio tuo pestem inter piratas in Portu Banamo diffundendi—non puto id esse viabile.”

source: “Why?” Lumian raised an eyebrow, amused.
target: “Cur?” inquit Lumian, supercilum levans et delectatus.

source: Franca straightened, her gaze unwavering.
target: Franca se rectam posuit, oculis constanter fixis.

source: “I don’t think we can completely separate the guilty pirates from innocent bystanders.
target: “Non puto nos posse piratas reos omnino a innocentiis spectatoribus separare.

source: The plague would inevitably affect the latter, causing them to die in despair.”
target: Peste certo illos afficiet, eos in desperatione mori faciendos.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “It was just a concept, a direction.
target: “Id tantum erat conceptus, directio.

source: We can refine the plan to address those concerns, and if it’s not feasible, we can abandon it.
target: Consilium emendare possumus ad has curas solvendas; et, si non idoneum erit, deserere possumus.

source: We can’t limit our thinking right from the start.”
target: Cogitationem a principio cohibere non possumus.

source: For example, by then, I might be a demigod and find a high-level replacement for the Bottle of Fiction, capable of containing all of Banamo Port with conditions allowing only pirates to enter or exit.
target: Exempli gratia, tum fortasse semideus sim et inveniam substitutum altum pro Ampulla Fictionis, quod totum Portum Banamo condere valeat sub condicionibus ut solum piratae ingressu aut egressu permittantur.

source: “No,” Franca shook her head.
target: “Non,” inquit Franca, caput movens.

source: “There are adventurers who moonlight as pirates, and many of them haven’t committed crimes deserving death.”
target: “Sunt viatores qui simul piratis fiunt, et plerique eorum crimina non fecerunt quae mortem mereantur.”

source: Lumian smiled and sighed.
target: Lumian subridet et suspirat.

source: “Then we’ll collaborate with the Aurora Order or find a Sequence 5 artifact from the Broker path to identify guilty targets.”
target: “Tum aut cum Ordine Aurora collaborabimus aut inveniemus artifactum Sequentionis V ex via Negotiatoris ad reos identificandos.”

source: Franca seriously thought for a moment.
target: Franca per momentum serio cogitavit.

source: “That won’t work either.
target: “Id quoque non operabitur.

source: We have our own crimes.
target: Nostra crimina habemus.

source: Many adventurers have killed pirates.
target: Multi viatores piratas interfecerunt.

source: Does that count as guilty?”
target: Num id inter reos iudicabitur?

source: Lumian was momentarily speechless, then laughed.
target: Lumian paulisper mutus fuit, deinde risit.

source: “You really are suited for switching to Provoker.
target: “Vere es aptus ad Provoker mutandum.

source: “I was just raising examples; my point being that a plan shouldn’t be dismissed outright.
target: “Exempla tantum proposui; mea idea est consilium non statim reiectum esse.

source: We need to analyze its feasibility and consider future changes.”
target: Eius efficaciam perscrutari et mutationes futuras considerare oportet.

source: “Okay.”
target: “Bene.”

source: Franca expressed her opinion and sighed quietly.
target: Franca sententiam suam exposuit et leniter suspiravit.

source: After some thought, she decided to speak frankly to Lumian, “Since discovering the vortex plan, you’ve become more aggressive, like when you first came to Trier.
target: Post aliquam meditationem, decernit sincera verba ad Lumian proferre: “Ex quo consilium vorticis detexisti, magis aggressivus factus es, sicut cum primum ad Trier venisti.

source: Or is it the Devil’s Whispers from Hisoka that’s constantly stirring your malice?
target: An sunt illi Diaboli Susurri a Hisoka, qui constantiter tuam malitiam excitant?

source: The Traveler’s Bag only mitigates its influence; it doesn’t completely eliminate the negative effects.
target: Saccus Viatoris tantum eius vim attenuat; non tamen omnino effectus adversos eliminat.

source: Lumian chuckled, somewhat self-deprecatingly.
target: Lumian subridens, aliquantulum se ipsum contemnens, risit.

source: “It’s a bit of both.”
target: “Est ex utroque.”

source: He then grew serious.
target: Tum grave factus est.

source: “But more importantly, I’ve come to some realizations.”
target: “Sed potissimum, ad nonnullas realizationes perveni.”

source: “What realizations?” Franca asked, puzzled.
target: “Quae realizationes?” quaesivit Franca, perplexa.

source: Lumian nodded.
target: Lumian annuit.

source: “I was going to remind you anyway.
target: “Te iam monebar.

source: You’ve been a Demoness for a long time.
target: Diu Demonissa fuisti.

source: Haven’t you noticed the inherent nature of this pathway?”
target: Nonne animadvertisti naturam inherentem huius viae?

source: Franca fell silent.
target: Franca tacita fuit.

source: Lumian continued in a low voice.
target: Lumian voce humili pergebat.

source: “Like the Hunter pathway, it inevitably brings catastrophe and calamity.
target: “Sicut via Venatoris, inevitabiliter calamitatem et cladem affert.

source: We are destined to belong to darkness and represent destruction.”
target: Fatum nobis est tenebris pertinere et exitium repraesentare.

source: “Think about it.
target: “Cogita de hoc.

source: What’s the general perception of Hunters and Demonesses among Beyonders?
target: Quae opinio generalis de Venatoribus et Demonissis apud Beyonders est?

source: Danger.
target: Periculum.

source: Hunters are seen as bloody dangers, and Demonesses as evil dangers.
target: Venatores ut pericula sanguinolenta, et Demonissae ut pericula mala existimantur.

source: We can’t escape this impression, nor can we deny it.
target: Non possumus hanc impressionem effugere, nec eam negare.

source: The subsequent potion digestion and advancement rituals will push us deeper into darkness unless you choose to stop advancing and remain where you are.
target: Ritūs digestionis potionis et progressus nos in tenebras plenius impellent, nisi decernas non ultra progredi et manere quo es.

source: Otherwise, we’ll face challenges that test our very souls.
target: Alioquin difficultatibus obveniemus, quae animas nostras ipsas probabunt.

source: “You could consider switching paths, but your only option would be the Hunter pathway.”
target: “Potes viam mutare cogitare, sed sola optio tua erit via Venatorum.”

source: Seeing Franca’s expression change but still remaining silent, Lumian suddenly laughed.
target: Videns expressionem Francae mutatam sed adhuc tacitam, Lumian subito risit.

source: “What I’m trying to say is, give up on purity; don’t shy away from darkness and evil.
target: “Id quod dicere conor est: abice puritatem; noli recedere a tenebris et malo.

source: We need to confront these things.
target: His rebus occurrere debemus.

source: Only then can we find ways to avoid evil and discover the light within the darkness.
target: Tunc tantum viās invenire possumus ad malum vitandum atque lucem in tenebris detegendam.

source: We will all be tainted by darkness.”
target: Omnes tenebris contaminabimur.

source: “We are stained black; we must strive not to fall, not to betray our inner principles.”
target: “Manemus nigri; contendere debemus ne cademus neque interiora nostra principia prodamus.”

source: Franca was silent for a while before sighing deeply.
target: Franca paulisper tacita fuit, deinde alte suspiravit.

source: “Affliction and Despair give me bad premonitions.
target: “Afflictio et Desperatio mihi mala praenotiones dant.

source: But walking in darkness, seeking light within it—won’t we be corrupted bit by bit and eventually fall completely?”
target: Sed ambulando in tenebris, quaerendo lucem in ea—nonne paulatim corrumpemur et tandem omnino cadamus?

source: Lumian chuckled. “Do we have any other choice?
target: Lumian subridens risit. “Habemusne aliam optionem?

source: We can only keep fighting our own darkness and evil until we die.”
target: Solum contra nostras tenebras et mala pugnare possumus usque ad mortem.”

source: Franca tersely acknowledged his words and expressed her thoughts, “Actually, all Beyonders are like this.
target: Franca breviter verba eius accepit et cogitationes suas exprimit: “Revera, omnes Beyonders ita sunt.

source: The paths of gods are inherently dangerous and inevitably lead to madness.
target: Viae deorum naturae periculosae sunt et necessario ad insaniam ducunt.

source: Hunters and Demonesses just make it more obvious and direct.”
target: Venatores et Demonissae hoc magis evidenter et directe efficiunt.”

source: She couldn’t imagine the struggles and pain if she had chosen the Devil pathway.
target: Non poterat fingere labores et dolores, si semitam Diaboli eligisset.

source: When the negative effects of Jenna’s Decency brooch wore off, Anthony returned and briefed Lumian and the others on the current situation in Banamo Port.
target: Cum effectus negativi fibulae Decentiae Jennae evanescebant, Anthony rediit et Lumiano aliisque de statu hodierno in Portu Banamo enarravit.

source: The Newins had indeed fled, and Great Shark Jörg and his men hadn’t boarded and were now missing.
target: Newins certe fugerunt, et Magnus Squalus Jörg eiusque milites navem conscendere non potuerunt et nunc ignoti sunt.

source: In the following two days, Lumian and his team disguised themselves and searched Banamo Port for the first mate, second mate, and boatswain of the Newins.
target: In duos dies subsequentes, Lumian et turma eius se in alias vestes induti sunt et Portum Banamo quaesiverunt ad reperiendum primum, secundum, et nautae praepositum Newins.

source: However, they found no significant leads, whether through social investigation or mystical tracking.
target: Sed nullas notabiles vestigia invenerunt, sive per inquisitionem socialem sive per indagationem mysticam.

source: Instead, they discovered some suspected associates of Admiral Deep Sea had also disappeared.
target: Proinde invenerunt aliquot socios suspectos Admiralis Profundi Maris quoque evanutos esse.

source: Lumian suspected Great Shark Jörg and his men had left Banamo Port through some secret means.
target: Lumian suspicabatur Magnum Squalus Jörg eiusque milites Portum Banamo per vias arcana discessisse.

source: Whether they returned to the Newins remained unknown.
target: Num ad Newins redeunt, ignotum manet.

source: In Trier, in an apartment in Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative.
target: In Trier, in habitatione in Quartiere Cathédralis Commemorativae.

source: Angoulême de Francois set up a ritual and summoned the messenger of the Seven of Cups.
target: Angoulême de Francois ritum instituit et nuntium Septem Poculorum evocavit.

source: He saw a rabbit-shaped Spirit Body emerge from the flames, dressed in an odd manner: a miniature silk top hat between its ears, tiny gold-rimmed glasses on its nose, a black trench coat clearly not meant for a rabbit, and holding an iron-black revolver sized for a large rabbit.
target: Vidit corpus spirituale forma cuniculi ex flammis emergere, insolite indutum: parvum pileum sericum inter aures, parvas speculas aureas in naso, atram tunicam trench quae pro cuniculo manifeste non apta erat, et revolverum ferrum nigrum, magnitudine cuniculo ingenti, tenentem.

source: The messenger of Hidden Blade is quite cute, with a unique style… Who knew she would dress her messenger like this…
target: Nuntius Falcis Occultae valde decorus est, cum singulari stilo… Quis putavit eam nuntium taliter vestire…

source: Angoulême picked up the prewritten letter and handed it to the adorably dressed rabbit messenger.
target: Angoulême epistulam prae-scripta collegit et tradidit nunti cuniculo venuste induto.

source: The rabbit gave him a cold, sharp glance.
target: Cuniculus ei intuentem frigidum atque acutum dedit.

source: Um… Angoulême retracted his previous thoughts.
target: Hem… Angoulême prius suas cogitationes retraxit.

source: In one of the motel rooms rented by Lumian and company in Banamo Harbor, Franca read Angoulême’s letter and said with some difficulty, “007 has a lead on the Mirror People and wants us to follow up, but we still haven’t found Great Shark Jörg.”
target: In uno ex conclavibus motel in Portu Banamo a Lumiano et sociis locatis, Franca epistolam Angoulême legendi dixit difficulter: “007 vestigium habet de Populis Specularibus et vult nos persequi; sed Magnum Squalum Jörg nondum invenimus.”

source: She was more interested in the secrets of the elves than the Mirror People.
target: Ea magis de arcana elforum quam de Populis Specularibus curabat.

source: Lumian leaned back, relaxed, and said, “The worst-case scenario is that Great Shark Jörg and his men have already returned to the Newins through secret means. We won’t get any results staying here.
target: Lumian relaxatus se recubuit et dixerat: “Pessimus eventus est quod Magnus Squalus Jörg eiusque milites iam per vias arcana ad Newins redeunt; hic manentes nullum fructum consequemur.

source: “So, let’s leave. Once the alert is lifted, those people might come out.
target: “Itaque eamus. Statim postquam monitum levabitur, illi homines fortasse emergent.

source: Meanwhile, we can make long-term plans to keep an eye on Banamo Port. Maybe the Newins will return for supplies.
target: Interim consilia diuturna facere possumus ut Portum Banamo vigilaverimus. Forsitan Newins redierint ad suppeditanda.

source: “Agreed,” Franca accepted reality.
target: “Consentit,” Franca rem accipiebat.

source: At that moment, Jenna noticed a problem: Rabbit Chasel was still in the room.
target: Illo momento, Jenna rem animadvertit: Rabbit Chasel adhuc in conclavi manebat.
